commands.command: pnpm --filter @fairbite/api exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/unit/identity/emailExist.spec.ts
commands.detail: 3 tests: adapter delegation to the identity service, false propagation, and the normalize/reject input boundary.

6 tests against the real HTTP server, PostgreSQL and Redis: exact pinned document true/false, case+whitespace normalization, BAD_USER_INPUT, public-access 403 without the handshake, the RATE_LIMITED abuse cap on repeated probing, and no writes on lookup.

evidenceStatus.reason: The apps list includes web, app and rider, so the evidence checker requires both web (playwright/webJourney) and device evidence. Neither harness exists yet (W16 and W19), so this record stays NOT_VERIFIED and is never counted as evidenced.

knownLimits: The contract is an enumeration oracle by design: any caller with the public handshake can learn whether an address is registered. Mitigated by the shared per-caller (60/min) and per-address (10/min) Redis limits and by returning nothing else; a stricter product policy would need an owner decision, not an invented behaviour.
Existence is status-independent on purpose (a suspended account keeps its unique address), which is recorded here rather than silently choosing either behaviour.
